description: What US stocks are at an entry right now, on the live board? The names at an entry, each with its entry window: the candidates a disciplined agent considers, and the ones that would be a chase. Live intraday ranked buy-list candidates among US stocks and ETFs (the crypto book lists coins) while their entry windows (READY/SETTING UP) are still open. dip: {ok, codes, setup}: present only for oversold-pullback candidates; a dip buy only on a completed hourly turn above the entry-quality and depth floors. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_buy_list_live
